methods.B0_continuous_target: Unquantized target branch; upper bound only.
methods.B1_centered_covariance: K=64 bank medoids under train-only covariance-whitened residual distance.
methods.B2_phase_residual: Four phase-specific K=64 bank medoid sets under raw residual distance.
methods.B3_dynamic_action_medoids: Per-state K=64 deterministic action-space FPS medoids from the valid common bank.
methods.B4_state_action_vq: Per-state K=64 FPS in a state-conditioned action-autoencoder latent trained only for action reconstruction.
methods.LJ_linear_j_atlas: State-neighbor interpolated train-only local Jacobian predictions; bank actions only and no pseudoinversion.
methods.MC_NCEA: Five-member shared-trunk predictor with four phase heads; dynamic mode-conditioned predicted-effect atlas.
methods.NCEA: Five-member global nonlinear consequence ensemble; dynamic predicted-effect atlas over valid bank actions.
methods.O1_true_effect_oracle: Per-state K=64 atlas and target assignment using true simulator effects for the common bank and target.
methods.O2_linear_j_oracle: Diagnostic alias for the LJ predicted-effect atlas used to define the O1-O2 gap.
methods.P3_mode_shuffled_atlas: MC-NCEA architecture trained with task-stratified shuffled phase/head assignments.
methods.P4_state_shuffled_atlas: NCEA architecture trained after shuffling state features within task and phase.
methods.P5_effect_shuffled_atlas: NCEA architecture trained after shuffling continuous effects and contact labels within task and phase.
methods.P6_random_latent_atlas: Frozen random trunk with ridge readout, matched hidden width and ensemble count.
methods.UG_NCEA: Calibration-frozen uncertainty score; NCEA/MC-NCEA used on the lowest-risk 50/70/90 percent and the frozen strongest baseline elsewhere.
